news.headline: Jets elevate Sterling Shepard with Adonai Mitchell in question
news.description: The Jets promoted veteran Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, as starting WR Adonai Mitchell is questionable with a finger injury, and three other Jets receivers are on injured reserve.

news.headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
news.description: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.

news.headline: QB Sam Darnold back Sunday, but Seahawks down two safeties
news.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold will start Sunday, but the defending Super Bowl champions will be without both starting safeties as Julian Love and Ty Okada have been ruled out.

news.headline: Colts officially place WR Alec Pierce on IR with heel issue
news.description: The Colts officially placed receiver Alec Pierce on injured reserve Saturday, starting the clock on a potential return as he attempts to rehab and rejoin the lineup.

news.headline: Rams targeting Week 4 return for WR Puka Nacua
news.description: The Rams are targeting a Week 4 return for wide receiver Puka Nacua, who is doubtful to play against the Broncos.

news.headline: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
news.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors say could sideline him for three to four weeks, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

news.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley to be 'fearless' vs. Bears despite stinger
news.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley plans to play "fearless" Monday night against the Chicago Bears as he eyes a return from a stinger injury.

news.headline: Commanders rule RG Cosmi, TE Okonkwo, LB Luvu out Sunday
news.description: Right guard Sam Cosmi (concussion), tight end Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) and linebacker Frankie Luvu (groin) won't play Sunday vs. the Seahawks.

news.headline: Jayden Daniels avoids IR after elbow injury
news.description: Ian Rapoport shares encouraging news on Jayden Daniels' elbow injury, with the Commanders hopeful their quarterback will return sooner rather than later.
